user.title: Action Suggestion
user.description: Choose the Areas to learn from. Manual state changes on entities in these Areas are the only data this integration ever looks at - see the README for what counts as "manual".

init.title: Action Suggestion options
init.description: Thresholds for the frequency/consistency engine - how a pattern is recognised and when it's confident enough to become a suggestion.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Wipes all learned events and patterns. Mainly for testing/troubleshooting.

execute_suggestion.name: Execute suggestion
execute_suggestion.description: Runs the action currently suggested by the targeted suggestion sensor(s), with this call's own context - so it reinforces the pattern like any other manual action.
